stumbles.quote: `query` is the line number of the query in `QUERY_FILE`.
stumbles.why: Doesn't say whether line numbers start at 0 or 1. The example shows `"query": 1`, but the reader can't tell whether that is the first line or the second.

stumbles.quote: If the index was built with `--keep-float`, each search rescores its top 100 candidates
stumbles.why: `--keep-float` is a build option, and the text never explains it or the build command. A reader can't tell how to build an index this way. It also doesn't say what happens if `-k` is greater than 100.

stumbles.quote: `--bits N` sets the quantization width used for the search.
stumbles.why: The text doesn't say which values of N are valid. It only mentions 2 and 4. It also doesn't say whether the width has to be at most the width the index was built with.

point: `remex search` takes an index and a file of comma-separated query vectors and writes top-k ids and scores as JSON Lines. `--bits` trades recall for speed, and rescoring happens only if the index was built with `--keep-float`.
